card: Replaces nullable smart pointers with util::NotNullUniquePtr for CreateNewBlock, CreateNewTemplate, and internal pimpl members across subsystems including AddrMan, CDBWrapper, and TxDownloadManager. It also introduces MakeNotNullUnique and MakeNotNullShared helpers to streamline non-null pointer construction. Methods and structs that are guaranteed non-null currently use nullable pointers, creating confusing and dead null checks across call sites. The author notes that compile-time non-null enforcement clarifies invariants and removes dead branches in test coverage and mutation testing. No dependencies are declared.
changed_since_previous: Added `util::MakeNotNullUnique` and `util::MakeNotNullShared` helper templates in `src/util/not_null.h` and adopted them across initialization sites in validation, networking, dbwrapper, and tests.
evidence: PR description: 'Pointers that are never null still have confusing null checks (with possible error handling return branches), which are always dead in coverage reports or when applying mutation testing.'
Commit fa071a2c45 notes the pimpl changes were suggested in review on #34844.
problem: Functions and structs that never hold or return nullptr use standard nullable smart pointers, obscuring API contracts. This leads to inconsistent and dead null-check branches across call sites that clutter coverage and mutation testing reports.

risk.why: A mistake in pointer construction or an incorrectly assumed non-null return could cause an unexpected abort or crash, though the wrapped allocations are strictly non-null.

scope_notes: Touches diverse subsystems (mining, networking, validation interface, dbwrapper) to replace pointer types with `NotNull` wrappers and remove now-redundant null checks.
summary: Replaces nullable smart pointers with `util::NotNullUniquePtr` (or const references) for `CreateNewBlock`, `BlockTemplateManager::CreateNewTemplate`, and internal pimpl members across subsystems including `AddrMan`, `CDBWrapper`, `TxDownloadManager`, and `TxRequestTracker`. Adds `util::MakeNotNullUnique` and `util::MakeNotNullShared` helper constructors and removes dead null checks at call sites in mining RPCs, fee estimation, and unit tests.
